name: Rectangle 4
text: A role-based web application that connects donors with active community campaigns.

name: Rectangle 11
text: Make it easier to discover causes, give securely through a simulated checkout, and keep a clear record of each successful gift.

name: Rectangle 15
text: Guests explore campaigns. Donors manage gifts and receipts. Administrators manage campaigns and review platform activity.

name: Rectangle 19
text: React and Vite client, Express API, and a Prisma-backed PostgreSQL mode, with a JSON demo mode for local showcase.

name: Rectangle 20
text: One experience from campaign discovery to verified receipt.

name: Rectangle 4
text: Donation processes can feel fragmented when discovery, payment records, and follow-up live in separate places.

name: Rectangle 11
text: Donors need clear campaign details and categories before choosing a cause.

name: Rectangle 15
text: Without organized records, donors may struggle to confirm what happened to a donation.

name: Rectangle 19
text: Campaign updates, receipt handling, and reporting can take time when managed by hand.

name: Rectangle 23
text: Sensitive donor information needs controlled access and a reliable audit trail.
